items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: I never knew what happened to her after that because we got caught up in the fog.

ctx.x: and - they had the bands to play at the Criterion Theatre. Every week they would have different things. That's the time little Mitzi Green was a very popular singer. She could sing in 3 or 4 different languages. She was a fore-runner - she was a petite like Thelma Carpenter. She was before Miss Lena Horne and people like that because she could sing in the different languages. I never knew what happened to her after that because we got caught up in the fog.
Did she ever sing with your band, Mitzi Green?
